title: Microstrip on alumina (εr = 9.8, h = 0.635 mm, W = 0.6 mm), 5 mm long between two 50 Ω lumped ports at its ends (pcb.port sheets to the ground floor), at 1 GHz
source: E. Hammerstad, Ø. Jensen, Accurate models for microstrip computer-aided design, IEEE MTT-S International Microwave Symposium Digest, 1980, pp. 407–409 (Z0 50.66 Ω, ε_eff 6.548), the line's ABCD matrix between 50 Ω terminations (D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., §4.4); evaluated independently of the code: `cargo run --release -p emcraft-theory --example pcb_line_reference -- 0.600075 0.635 9.8 5 50 1` (|S11| 0.0034782, |S21| 0.9999940, delay 4.26794e-11 s)

quantities.reason: +1.3e-3 measured: the line's own mismatch to 50 Ω and the feeds' reactance (each sheet 0.635 mm tall)

−1.76° measured: the two feeds' series inductance (about 0.25 nH each, a sheet as tall as the substrate), which the line's closed form leaves out; the line itself is checked to 0.005° by pcb-microstrip-fem
